uploadStockAdjustment.title: Upload Stock Adjustment
uploadStockAdjustment.subtitle: Bulk upload stock adjustments (stock on hand) from an Excel file (max {{max}} rows).
uploadStockAdjustment.confirmContent: Submit {{count}} row(s) to warehouse {{warehouse}}? The uploaded Qty becomes the new Stock on Hand.
uploadStockAdjustment.hintUpload: Download the template, fill in data starting from row 6, then upload here. Yellow columns are optional.
uploadStockAdjustment.summaryFixHint: Fix failed rows in the table (click a cell to edit), then resubmit.

message.import: File does not match the template. Download the latest template and refill it.
message.limit: Row count exceeds the maximum of {{max}} rows.
message.cellError: Some cells are still invalid — fix them in the table before submitting.
message.duplicate: Duplicate MaterialCode in the file — merge/remove the duplicate rows before submitting.
message.nothingToSubmit: Nothing to submit — all rows already succeeded. Edit a cell to mark a row for resubmission.
message.downloadFailed: Failed to download the template. Try again or contact your administrator.

uploadStockAdjustment.noActiveWarehouse: No active warehouse — pick a warehouse in the warehouse switcher first
uploadStockAdjustment.confirmDeleteHint: Material {code} will be removed from the upload list.
